page.overview:
What is Circle of Power?

300px|A Circle of Power 300px|Activated Circle of Power

Circles of Power give Geralt a buff for 5 minutes and are stackable up to all 5 circles. They appear as a faint shimmer when they are not activated by the medallion, and show up as bright red aura after being activated by the medallion, using the Z key. Their powers are bestowed when Geralt walks through them while exposed by a medallion scan. The Witcher medallion glows and emits a distinct sound when Geralt is within hidden the Circles of Power. {| class="fandom-table sortable" width="100%" ! width="15%" | Circle Name ! width="15%" | Symbol ! width="70%" | Effect

Vitality regeneration +2 / Vitality regeneration in combat +1
